Name: Choice Specs
Description: Your first Special Move in a Battle has its Move Power increased by 1, but you cannot use any other Move for the rest of the Battle.

Name: Goggle Specs
Description: Reveals hidden traps and Invisible Pokémon

Name: Scope Lens
Description: Your all Moves score a Critical Hit on a 5-6.

Name: Whiff Specs
Description: When the bearer throws an Item or uses a Move with a Range greater than 1 tile, they roll a d6. On a 1-3, they miss the target.

Name: X-Ray Specs
Description: Enables Pokémon to see through walls.
